title: Penalty for False or Misleading Advertisement

content.scenario: A company published an advertisement claiming that their energy drink could cure diseases, which was found to be false. The Central Consumer Protection Authority (CCPA) took action against the company.
content.outcome: The company was fined five lakh rupees for publishing a false and misleading advertisement.
